Key deliverables:
• Three ad variations (image or short video) paired with persuasive copy geared toward the 36-50 demographic  
• Custom audiences and look-alikes based on interest, behaviour and demographic data for “individuals seeking health insurance”  
• Native lead form configured with qualifying questions and automatic CRM/email forwarding  
• Ongoing A/B testing plan with weekly performance reports that highlight CPL, CTR and other core metrics

The campaign is considered successful when leads arrive consistently and costs trend downward through optimisation.

leads.title: HVAC Assessment Report
leads.description:
I need a qualified HVAC engineer to carry out a detailed assessment of an existing system that is showing signs of poor airflow. The primary goal is to diagnose the root cause of this malfunction and provide a clear, data-driven report that I can hand to my facilities team for follow-up work.

During your site visit you will be expected to:
• Inspect all major components—air handler, ductwork, dampers, filters, fans, and controls.
• Measure static pressure, airflow rates, and temperature differentials to verify performance against design specs.
• Identify any mechanical, electrical, or control faults that are contributing to the airflow problem.
• Recommend corrective actions ranked by urgency and cost-effectiveness.

The final report should include test results, annotated photos where helpful, and concise recommendations that a maintenance crew can implement without further clarification.

If you have experience using diagnostic tools such as manometers, anemometers, and data loggers—and can turn around a professional report quickly—let’s talk.

I need a skilled PCB designer to convert my existing through-hole PCB, designed in Fritzing, into an SMD PCB for production using KiCad. The design works great, but I need it to be SMD.

Requirements:
- Convert the following components from through-hole to SMD: 
  - ICs (including ESP32, A7670G modules, and charge controller)
- Use of standard footprints for all SMD components.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in KiCad
- Experience with SMD PCB design and layout
- Familiarity with the specified components (ESP32, A7670G, charge controllers)
- Attention to detail and accuracy in design

Please provide samples of previous SMD PCB designs.

leads.title: User Testing for Digital Products Store
leads.description:
Test a small digital-downloads shop and tell us everything that is wrong
Budget: $15–30 per tester for about 90 minutes · Hiring: 3–5 people · Turnaround: 3 days
We sell printable PDFs, spreadsheets, planners and cut files. The shop is new and has never had a real customer. We want you to use it the way a customer would, and tell us every point where you hesitate, get confused, or can't do what you meant to do.
You do not need to install, buy, or set anything up
No card, ever. The shop runs in test mode for you: every flow is the real one, and no payment is taken. If any page asks for card details, stop and tell us. That is the most serious thing you could find.
No spreadsheet to fill in, no report to write. The checklist is inside the site. A yellow button floats on every page; tap it and the questions are there, grouped by section. Your answers save as you type.
One link does everything. It turns test mode on, opens your checklist, and sends your findings back.
What we need from you
Work through the checklist on the device you were hired for. There are 45 checks in five sections:
buying as a first-time visitor
your account and order history
what happens when things go wrong
how the shop looks
the whole journey on a phone
Each check has a box for what happened and a 1–5 score.
Screenshots of anything wrong or ugly, on the check they belong to. Every check has an "Add a screenshot" button, or you can paste one in. Short screen-recording clips are the only thing to send separa

leads.title: Creative Director for Streetwear/Fashion Brand
leads.description:
Project Title: Creative Director Needed for Streetwear/Fashion Brand (Content, Design, Calendar & Marketing)

Project Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Creative Director to lead the visual and strategic direction for our fashion brand specializing in hoodies. We need a creative partner who can handle end-to-end strategy, from designing upcoming apparel lines to planning and executing content shoots.

Key Responsibilities:

Apparel & Graphic Design: Design stylish, modern hoodie collections, tech packs, and print-ready graphics/mockups.

Content Creation & Shoot Direction: Concept, plan, and direct product shoots (photo/video), including mood boards, model direction, and styling instructions.

Content Calendar & Strategy: Develop a structured 30-day/60-day social media and content calendar to drive brand engagement.

Marketing Strategy: Provide visual and promotional strategies to grow brand awareness and launch new hoodie drops successfully.

Requirements:

Proven portfolio showcasing fashion/streetwear design and direction.

Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere/InDesign).

Strong understanding of fashion trends, social media aesthetics, and visual storytelling.

Ability to deliver print-ready assets and clear, actionable calendars.

To Apply:
Please share:

Links to your portfolio or previous streetwear/fashion work.

A brief summary of how you approach a new drop campaign.

Your estimated timeline for a full campaign cycle.

leads.title: Vibrant Instagram & Facebook Images
leads.description:
I’m refreshing my brand’s presence on Instagram and Facebook and need a designer who can both create eye-catching new posts and give a quick polish to a few drafts I already have. Every asset must be image-based and carry a colorful, vibrant look that instantly builds brand awareness while feeling consistent across both platforms.

Here’s how I picture the workflow:  
• You receive my brand guidelines, sample photography, and the rough posts that need touching up.  
• You design a set of new feed-ready images (square and vertical versions) plus refine the provided drafts, matching fonts, colors, and overall energy so the entire grid feels cohesive.  
• Final files come back in layered PSD/AI along with web-ready JPG/PNG exports, neatly named and sized for Instagram and Facebook.  

I value quick communication, respect for brand identity, and a bit of creative flair that makes people stop scrolling. Let me know your turnaround time and how many polished, vibrant visuals you can deliver in each batch.

leads.title: Solar Battery Retrofit Needed
leads.description:
I need an additional battery retrofitted to my existing 5-10 kW grid-tied solar PV system. The primary goal is to store excess energy. 

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience with grid-tied solar systems
- Knowledge of battery integration and retrofitting
- Electrical engineering background is a plus
- Relevant certifications in solar energy systems

I have a 5.2kWh Givenergy battery already up and running.  I have sourced an additional battery of the same specification and would like someone to attach it in parallel to the existing battery and commission it please.

leads.title: German B2B Campaign Copy - HARD DEADLINE - Friday morning
leads.description:
ONLY NATIVE GERMAN SPEAKERS PLEASE

I’m rolling out a Halloween-themed B2B campaign aimed at fleet and HSE managers and I need the English master copy turned into sharp, German-language marketing assets—fast.

Scope  
• Translate and adapt ±1 200 words that appear on a set of near-identical postcards and two landing pages.  
• Keep the playful, humorous hook in the opening lines, then ease into a casual yet professional tone for the body and call-to-action.  
• Make sure every headline, subhead, and paragraph fits my existing design templates (I’ll share the InDesign/PDF layouts so you can check character limits and line breaks).  

What you’ll receive  
• The full English campaign, including keyword list, design files, and reference notes.  
• Brand guidelines and the final postcard/landing-page mock-ups.

What I expect back  
• Final German copy in an editable doc (Google Docs or Word) clearly segmented by asset.  
• A marked-up PDF or comment sheet flagging any space issues or design tweaks you recommend.  
• Delivery no later than Friday morning (CET) so my designer can drop the text straight in.

If you’re a native-level German copywriter with B2B experience and a knack for creative localisation, I’d love to hear from you.

leads.title: Luxury Real Estate Video Editor
leads.description:
I regularly shoot high-end property footage and now need a creative editor who can turn my raw clips into polished, thumb-stopping Instagram Reels that elevate my luxury real estate brand.

You’ll receive 4K footage, a short brief, and brand guidelines (logo, colours, fonts). From there, please craft 30–60-second vertical videos optimised for Instagram by:

• Selecting the best takes and colour-grading for a cinematic yet true-to-life look  
• Adding smooth transitions, tasteful motion graphics, captions, and royalty-free music that match a luxury aesthetic  
• Delivering a ready-to-post MP4 plus the editable Premiere Pro or Final Cut project file for any quick tweaks

Acceptance criteria  
– Reels meet Instagram specs (1080×1920, under 60 s)  
– Colours align with my brand palette and remain consistent across clips  
– On-screen text is typo-free, fully legible on mobile, and placed away from UI elements  
– Final files arrive within the agreed turnaround time

If you can weave in drone shots, sound design, or alternate cuts for future YouTube uploads, that flexibility is appreciated but not required right now.

I have a steady pipeline of new listings, so this could become an ongoing collaboration. Please share links to any property tours, lifestyle reels, or other luxury work you’ve edited so I can get a sense of your storytelling style. Looking forward to seeing how you can bring these homes to life on Instagram.

leads.title: إعادة تصميم واجهة منصة back office
leads.description:
أعمل حالياً على منصة لإدارة الحجوزات بين العملاء ومزوّدي الخدمات وقد أصبحت وظائفها مكتملة، لكن واجهتها لم تعد تلبّي احتياجات سهولة الاستخدام التي نسعى إليها. أريد إعادة تصميم شاملة لكل الأقسام — من إدارة العملاء والموردين والمستخدمين وصولاً إلى الحجوزات، النزاعات، الإلغاءات، الخصومات، الشات، العمولات والتسويات، والقسم المالي — مع مراعاة هوية لونية موحّدة سأزوّدك بها لاحقاً.  

الأولوية القصوى هي جعل تجربة المستخدم بسيطة وسَلِسَة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية، مع بنية معلومات منظَّمة للغاية تعالج كثرة الخيارات الحالية دون إرباك. أتوقع واجهة متجاوبة تعمل بسلاسة على الكمبيوتر والجوال مع نمط تصميم حديث يركّز على الوضوح أكثر من الزينة.

أحتاجك أن تسلّم:  
• ملفات التصميم الكاملة (يفضَّل Figma) مرتبة حسب الصفحات والمكوّنات  
• دليلاً مبسطاً لنظام الألوان والخطوط والحالات المختلفة (UI Kit)  
• مخططات تدفّق توضح منطق انتقال المستخدم بين الأقسام الرئيسة  
• نماذج تفاعلية جاهزة للاختبار مع فريق التطوير

الموعد المطلوب للتسليم في أقرب وقت ممكن، لذا أرجو أن ترفق في عرضك مقترحاً تفصيلياً يشمل مراحل العمل والجدول الزمني.

leads.title: Scientific Illustrator / Graphic Designer for Biomaterials Research
leads.description:
Looking for a scientific illustrator/designer to create a professional illustration related to biomaterials, tissue engineering, and nerve regeneration.

I would like to develop one main scientific illustration that can be adapted for multiple purposes, including research papers, graphical abstracts/figures, conference posters, and presentation slides. Ideally, the illustration should have a professional 3D or semi-realistic scientific style.

I already have an AI-generated example as a rough concept, so the overall idea and structure are already established. The main task is to recreate and refine the concept into an accurate, high-quality, professional scientific illustration.

It would be great if you have experience or a background in biomaterials, biomedical engineering, tissue engineering, life sciences, or scientific/medical illustration, as this would make it easier to communicate and understand the scientific concept.

leads.title: Modern Mountain Home Design
leads.description:
We have designed a mountain home with mountain views that we are building. 
I would need to have the architectural drawings turned into interior and exterior 3d rendering for pre-sale activities.

leads.title: Android Game Daily Testers Needed
leads.description:
I’m preparing a soft-launch of my new Android game and want a small, committed play-test group before going public. I need a minimum of 12 testers who will install the current build, open it every day for roughly five minutes, and then share brief impressions.  

The focus is on user feedback rather than formal bug hunting. I’m particularly interested in how the gameplay feels, whether the graphics and overall design are appealing, and if the interface is clear and intuitive. Any crashes or obvious issues you notice are, of course, worth mentioning, but the priority is honest, qualitative feedback on the player experience.

You’ll receive a download link (Google Play internal test track) and a simple feedback form. For 15 consecutive days, open the game once, play a quick round, and jot down your thoughts in the form—nothing lengthy, just genuine reactions.

Deliverables (per tester)  
• Daily feedback form (1–2 minutes to complete) for 15 days  
• A short summary report on day 15 covering overall enjoyment, graphics/design impressions, and UI clarity  

I’ll review submissions each evening and release payment once all daily entries and the final summary are received. Reliable participation for the full 15-day window is essential—if that sounds easy enough, I’d love to have you onboard.

leads.title: Complete Children’s Book Illustration Package
leads.description:
I’m looking for an illustrator who can take my 50-page children’s story from blank canvas to bookshelf. The project involves creating lively cartoon artwork, keeping the seven main characters dynamic and action-oriented, and bathing every scene in a bright, vibrant palette.  

Beyond the page art itself, I also need the production pieces that let a book go public: a polished front-and-back cover, interior layout that meets Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing specs, an embedded ISBN, and a scannable retail barcode. Everything must arrive press-ready for both print and Kindle (fixed-layout) upload.

Key deliverables  
• Full-color illustrations for ±50 interior pages (300 dpi, CMYK)  
• Front & back cover design with spine, bleed, and trim marks  
• Kindle-ready file (mobi/epub) plus print-ready PDF  
• High-resolution barcode placement and ISBN incorporation  
• Layered source files (PSD/AI) and final flattened exports  

I’ll supply the manuscript and any reference notes on page turns or pacing as soon as we start. If you’re comfortable working in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, or comparable tools and can guide the book smoothly through KDP requirements, I’d love to see your portfolio of bright, energetic cartoon work and discuss timelines.

leads.title: High-Volume Hiring Workflow & Shift Matching Platform with Candidate KYC Integration -- 2
leads.description:
High-Volume Hiring Workflow & Shift Matching Platform with Candidate KYC Integration

Project Description

I am looking for an experienced developer/team to build a production-ready, cloud-based high-volume hiring workflow platform for managing multiple candidates, identity-verification status, job/shift availability, candidate matching, and permitted booking/application workflows.

The intended workflow is:

1. Candidate Management
    * Import/manage 50–100+ candidates through CSV/Excel.
    * Each candidate has their own profile, email/account information, preferred locations, availability and employment preferences.
    * Dashboard should show each candidate’s current workflow status.
2. Candidate-Controlled KYC / Selfie Verification
    * When the external hiring platform legitimately provides an identity/selfie/liveness verification step or link, the candidate must complete it personally on their own device.
    * My system should send/display the verification request to the correct candidate.
    * The candidate completes their own selfie/liveness verification.
    * Where an authorized status/API/integration is available, the system should record statuses such as:
        KYC Required → Sent → In Progress → Verified/Completed → Failed/Retry Required.
    * No KYC bypass, automated selfie, impersonation or manipulation of identity verification.
3. Job/Shift Availability Monitoring
    * Monitor job/shift availability by location using authorized APIs, feeds or other pe

leads.title: Hindu Arti YouTube Channel Launch
leads.description:
I’m ready to bring a dedicated Hindu Arti channel to life and would like a partner who can guide the entire journey—from creating the actual Arti videos through to launching and optimising the channel itself.  

Focus  
We will begin exclusively with Arti content (morning, evening, festival-specific, etc.), building a consistent style and devotional atmosphere before expanding to stories or teachings later.

Scope of assistance needed  
• Content creation: research, scripting, on-screen or voice-over performance, and sourcing copyright-cleared visuals or music.  
• Channel setup: naming ideas, logo and banner design, keyword research, playlist structure, and basic SEO so each upload reaches the right devotees.  
• Video editing: clean cuts, smooth transitions, subtitling (English & Hindi preferred), volume levelling, and simple motion graphics that respect the devotional tone.

Deliverables & acceptance criteria  
1. Fully branded channel ready for public launch (artwork, descriptions, playlists, tags).  
2. At least three completed Arti videos (1080p minimum, clear audio, under 8 minutes each) uploaded as unlisted for review.  
3. Editable project files (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve) plus all raw assets with proper naming.  
4. A short handover guide covering upload workflow, thumbnail templates, and basic analytics checkpoints.

Proposal expectations  
Please send a detailed project proposal outlining your creative approach, timeline, and the specific tools you’ll use. H

leads.title: Europe Trade Finance Bankers Database
leads.description:
I’m conducting market research that requires a comprehensive contact database of every banker responsible for trade finance across all European countries. The final file should be delivered in Excel or CSV and organised by country so it’s easy for me to filter and analyse.

For each entry I need the following fields:
• Bank name  
• Country  
• Contact full name  
• Job title (specifically tied to trade finance)  
• Corporate email address (no info@ or support@)  
• Direct mobile or direct desk number

Accuracy and freshness are more important than sheer volume; bounced emails or generic switchboard numbers won’t be useful to me. If one bank has multiple regional trade-finance heads, feel free to list them all.

To help me choose quickly, please outline your experience sourcing B2B contact data in highly regulated sectors such as banking, and mention the tools or methods you rely on (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, official bank directories, direct calling). No lengthy proposals are necessary—just a concise note proving you can reach decision-level contacts and keep data GDPR-compliant.

I will review samples before awarding, then expect a first milestone covering a handful of countries so we can confirm format and quality before you scale to the remaining nations.

leads.title: n8n Automation Workflow Build & Optimization
leads.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Automation Developer to build an automated workflow for our business.

The project will involve connecting AI, n8n, APIs, and third-party tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve our workflow.

Requirements:
Strong experience with n8n
OpenAI / ChatGPT API integration
AI agents and automation workflows
API & webhook integrations
CRM or database integration

Experience with business process automation
Please share 2–3 relevant AI automation or n8n projects you have completed.

Also include your estimated timeline and best quote.
Start your proposal with “AI Automation” so we know you have read the requirements.

leads.title: Pemba Gardens Informational Website Build
leads.description:
I’m ready to launch a clean, responsive informational site for Pemba Gardens, our outdoor events venue. The homepage has to lead with a compelling “About Us” narrative that captures the atmosphere of the garden and immediately reassures visitors they have found the right place for weddings, parties, and corporate functions.

Beyond that first impression, I need a handful of focused pages so guests can explore the venue visually and get in touch without friction.

Deliverables  
• Gallery page that loads quickly and displays full-width, high-quality photos of the grounds and past events.  
• Testimonials page where I can post client quotes (simple CMS section is fine).  
• Embedded Google Map showing our exact location.  
• WhatsApp contact form/button that opens a chat with our business number on mobile and desktop.  
• Fully responsive build, optimised for modern browsers and mobile.  
• Easy-to-update back-end (WordPress, Webflow, or comparable CMS—open to your suggestion).  

Acceptance  
A brief hand-off call or video walkthrough so I know how to add new photos and testimonials myself, plus a week of post-launch support for any tweaks.

If this fits your skill set, let’s get started and have Pemba Gardens online quickly. We already have a domain name.

leads.title: Personal company  Website with all the functions needed and similar to other sample sites i will provide.
leads.description:
I need a single-page site that mirrors the look and feel of our existing main website while focusing entirely on today’s interest-rate offering. The page must be laid out in a clear, corporate-professional style and load quickly on all modern browsers and mobile devices.

I want to mimic these sites:
https://origna8.com/
and 
https://sinocruzmortgage.com/

Core elements
• Dynamic table or module that lets me update interest rates easily (manually through the CMS or via a simple CSV/JSON feed—open to your advice).  
• Highly visible buttons that point to our online application and to a downloadable PDF version.  
• Native contact form (name, email, phone, message) that delivers submissions to my company inbox and logs them in the site’s back-end.  
• Short testimonial carousel—logo, quote, name/title—for added credibility.

Visual direction
Think clean blues and greys, balanced white space, typography consistent with our primary site, and plenty of room for rate tables to breathe. I will provide brand guidelines, fonts, logos, and a staging link to the main site for reference.

Tech & hand-off
Please build in WordPress (Elementor or Gutenberg blocks are fine) or lightweight HTML/CSS with a simple script for the rate table—whichever you feel keeps maintenance low and performance high. When finished, hand over:  
1. Fully responsive, production-ready files / or WordPress export  
2. Instructions for updating rates and testimonials  
3. Any custom code commented and documented

T

leads.description:

Somos una empresa consolidada del sector de comercio exterior y logística. Estamos actualizando nuestro sitio web y buscamos un/a diseñador/a experto/a con dominio fluido del idioma español para rediseñar y refrescar el contenido visual de nuestra página principal (Home Page). 

Buscamos sustituir las fotografías e imágenes actuales de la web por propuestas más modernas, limpias y profesionales, adaptadas estrictamente a la línea gráfica y paleta de colores de nuestra presentación corporativa.

leads.title: Square Colorful Cookbook Design
leads.description:
I have all the written recipes laid out and low-res reference photos for each dish, but the original image files are missing. What I need now is a vibrant, 8 x 8-inch cookbook that bursts with colour and artwork while letting new, high-quality food photography take centre stage.

Here is the scope in a nutshell:  
• Design style: colourful and artistic throughout, with playful graphic accents that still keep the pages organised and easy to follow.  
• Format: square, 8 × 8 inches, exportable as print-ready PDF (CMYK, 300 dpi) plus an RGB PDF for digital viewing.  
• Image handling: every recipe needs a fresh, hi-res photo you either shoot yourself or source royalty-free. The visual appeal of those pictures is the top priority, so layouts must showcase them prominently.  
• Files I expect: packaged Adobe InDesign folder (or layered PSD/AI if you prefer) along with fonts and links—absolutely no AI-generated artwork or files.  
• Timeline and budget: I have a fixed ceiling of INR 3000 - 5,000, so efficient planning and clear milestone splits will be essential.

Page Count - 120 to 150 pages

If you excel at bold, mouth-watering layouts and can either create or secure stunning food photography to match, let’s talk details and page count.

leads.title: Build New Features for BajriX
leads.description:
BajriX is an active construction-materials marketplace running on React, React Native, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and AWS. I need an experienced developer who can drop straight into the existing repository, understand the current architecture and take the lead on building out new features while keeping the codebase clean, modular and well-documented.

Your day-to-day work will involve:  


Experience with e-commerce or marketplace logic, AWS authentication flows and third-party API integrations will make you especially effective here.

When you reply, please link to past work that shows similar responsibilities—code samples, GitHub repos or live projects are all welcome. Also include your typical availability and expected charges so we can map out milestones right away.

I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit and will be responsive for code reviews and product questions. Looking forward to seeing what you’ve built.

leads.title: 24-Hour Shopify Product Upload
leads.description:
I need about thirty-five new items pushed live on my Shopify store within the next 24 hours. All copy and imagery are ready to drop in, so the task is purely data entry and storefront configuration. Roughly a third of the SKUs include simple variants—mostly size and colour—so please create those options, connect the correct photos to each, and double-check pricing and inventory for accuracy.  

Collections, tags, and basic SEO fields (title, description, alt text) should be completed as you go so the products slot straight into my existing navigation. Once everything is published, run a quick front-end check to ensure each item appears correctly in its collection, the variants switch smoothly, and the thumbnails look crisp on desktop and mobile.  

Deliverables:  
• 35 visible products uploaded and organised  
• All variant options functioning with linked images  
• Descriptions, tags, SEO, and inventory fields populated  
• Storefront spot-check confirming no broken links or placeholder text  

I will provide immediate admin access and any additional guidance you need, but speed is vital—please confirm you can finish within the 24-hour window before accepting.

leads.title: Bold YouTube Thumbnail Design
leads.description:
I’m looking for someone who can translate each of my video ideas into a bold, colourful thumbnail that still feels polished and professional. I’ll hand over the video title, the key images I’d like featured, and any short phrases that absolutely must be included. From there, I need a 1280 × 720 JPG or PNG that balances strong imagery with concise, punchy text so viewers know exactly why they should click.

Here’s what matters most to me:  
• A clear focal point that blends both text and image without clutter.  
• Vivid colours with enough contrast to stand out in YouTube’s crowded sidebar.

leads.title: QuickBooks M-Pesa Workflow Integration
leads.description: I am looking for an experienced developer to build a middleware integration between QuickBooks Online and M-Pesa for automated supplier payments in Kenya. The system should connect to QuickBooks Online, retrieve approved/unpaid supplier bills and supplier payment details, and allow authorized users to initiate payments directly from the accounting workflow. The middleware should validate the supplier, bill amount, outstanding balance, payment details, and prevent duplicate payments before sending the payment request through the Safaricom M-Pesa B2C API. It should handle the M-Pesa asynchronous callback, capture the final transaction status, M-Pesa transaction ID, conversation ID, result code, and result description, and only mark the supplier bill as paid in QuickBooks after Safaricom confirms a successful transaction. The solution should include secure QuickBooks OAuth authentication, Safaricom Daraja API integration, payment status tracking, transaction logging, error handling, duplicate-payment protection, callback endpoints, and proper reconciliation between the actual M-Pesa payment and the corresponding QuickBooks BillPayment. The middleware should be designed securely and be scalable so that other payment methods such as bank APIs or PayPal can be added in the future.

leads.title: Visitor QR Check-In App
leads.description:
I’m building a simple yet secure solution that lets visitors enter and leave our gated community by scanning a QR code. The core flow is straightforward:

• Residents create a unique, time-bound QR code for each guest from within the same app (or their own resident view).  
• The visitor presents that code at the gate, security scans it, and the visit is automatically logged as “checked-in.”  
• On departure the guard scans again, closing the visit record as “checked-out.”

That check-in / check-out cycle is the only must-have for this first version. I do not need broader resident-notification features or an elaborate security dashboard right now—speed and reliability of the QR workflow are my priorities.

Deliverables I expect:
1. Cross-platform mobile app (Android + iOS) with two roles: Resident (code generator) and Security (scanner).  
2. Backend that stores visit logs securely and lets me export basic reports (CSV or similar).  
3. Simple admin credentials so I can add/remove residents myself.  
4. Brief deployment guide and source code.

Acceptance criteria:
• A visitor can’t be checked in unless the QR is valid, unused, and within its active window.  
• Duplicate or expired codes are rejected with a clear message.  
• All successful scans instantly create or close a record in the database, visible in an activity log.  
• App loads and scanning complete in under two seconds on a mid-range device.

I’m flexible on the tech stack; Flutter + Firebase or React Native + Supa

• Endpoint or script for bulk generation, plus a retrieval endpoint for single look-ups

Acceptance criteria  
• 1,000 QRs generated in under two minutes on a mid-range VPS  
• Each QR decodes to the correct, unique URL pattern I provide  
• Front-end fetch succeeds with CORS enabled and no console errors  

If you’ve handled QR libraries (like qrcode, goqr, or similar) and can wire up a lean REST API quickly, this should be straightforward. Let me know yo

A short L-angle test bracket (40×40×1.8 mm) showing the flat cut + forming tool feature applied and fully un-flattenable/flattenable in SolidWorks Sheet Metal.

• Produce two logs: one for executed trades with timestamps and confirmation IDs, and one for errors.  
• Run from a single command on Windows and include a brief README covering prerequisites, configuration (file path, account credentials, stake size), and how to start/stop the bot.  

Acceptance criteria

I will review schematics first, approve the component selection, and then move on to PCB and firmware stages. If you are experienced with UPS topologies, EMI/EMC compliance, and thermal design, I’m ready to get started right away.

I am launching a toilet-tissue paper brand on Amazon and need one partner who can handle the full front-end package at a shoestring budget. Your first priority will be A+ Content, but the brief also covers Sponsored Ads set-up/optimisation and building a cohesive Amazon Store so everything looks and performs as one unified brand experience.

For the A+ section I don't have idea exactly what I want: enhanced lifestyle images and infographics that speak to softness and sustainability, a clear product-comparison chart to position my packs against larger bulk offers, and rich copy that moves shoppers from curiosity to checkout. If you can shoot , make graphics or source photography, great—otherwise guide me on what I must provide.

Once the content is approved, roll straight into creating logical ad campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, simple keyword structure) that work within my minimal daily spend. Finally, stitch it all together in a clean three-page Amazon Store so customers see consistent messaging from ad click to final gallery.

Deliverables
• A+ Content module: images, infographics, comparison chart, narrative copy ready for upload  
• Ad account setup: campaigns, ad groups, keyword list, bids and concise optimisation notes  
• Amazon Store: layout, graphic assets, navigation and submitted for Amazon review  

Acceptance Criteria
• A+ modul

leads.title: Middle East-Based Food Content Creators Needed
leads.description:
Job Title:
Looking for Food Influencers / UGC Video Creators based in Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Jordan
Job Description:
Hello! We are a premium Indian Spice Brand launching our Shopify e-commerce store in the Middle East. We want to hire direct Content Creators / Influencers (No Agencies or Middlemen) who are permanently based in one of these countries: Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, or Jordan.
We will ship our high-quality spice samples directly from India to your home address for free.
What you need to do:
1. Receive our spice package.
2. Create a high-quality 60-second video (Cooking a recipe, food review, or an engaging unboxing video).
3. Post the video as a Reel/TikTok on your social media channel and tag our brand.
4. Allow us the rights to use your video on our Shopify store and social media pages.
Requirements:
• You must be living in Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, or Jordan.
• You must have an active Instagram or TikTok page focused on Food, Cooking, Recipes, or Lifestyle.
• Good lighting and clear camera/audio quality are a must.
If you are interested, please apply with a link to your Instagram/TikTok profile and your rates per video. We look forward to working with you!

leads.title: Minimalist Silicone Half-Mask Design
leads.description:
I’m creating a sleek, minimalistic half-mouth mask intended purely as a fashion accessory and need an experienced 3D artist or product designer to bring it to life in silicone.

Here’s what I’m after:
• A clean, understated shape that covers only the lower half of the face, free of excessive lines or surface details.  
• All contours optimised for comfortable wear and easy breathing—think smooth interior curves, subtle ventilation slits, no sharp edges.  
• Files delivered in STL (and OBJ if convenient) ready for high-resolution SLA or silicone mould printing, with clear wall-thickness guidelines and support recommendations.  
• Guidance on the best silicone grade and durometer for a soft yet durable finish, plus any tips on pigmenting for a uniform matte look.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Final CAD model fits the provided facial measurements (I’ll supply a neutral-expression head scan).  
2. Mask prints cleanly at 0.05 mm layer height without structural edits.  
3. Exploded view or step-by-step doc outlining mould creation for liquid silicone casting.

If you’ve previously prototyped wearable silicone pieces, I’d love to see examples. Let’s keep the design simple, elegant, and production-ready.

leads.title: Google Sheets Expert + Google Apps Script Expert + CRM Automation – Long-Term Support
leads.description:
We are looking for an experienced Google Sheets Expert, Google Apps Script Expert, and CRM Automation Developer for long-term technical support.

Our existing CRM and business management system is built using Google Sheets and Google Apps Script. We need a reliable developer who can:
- Understand and maintain the current system
- Fix bugs and technical issues
- Make improvements and add new features
- Maintain automation, data synchronization, lead management, agent management, and reporting systems
- Troubleshoot problems remotely and provide ongoing technical support

Important: This is NOT a project to build a new CRM from scratch. The selected developer should be comfortable working with existing Apps Script code.

Required Skills:
- Google Sheets
- Google Apps Script
- JavaScript
- CRM Automation
- Google Workspace
- Spreadsheet Automation
- API Integration
- Troubleshooting & Debugging

Long-Term Opportunity: Initially, we will assign a small task to check your understanding of our system. If satisfied, we aim to continue with regular support and future development.

To Apply: Please share:
1. Your experience with Google Apps Script and Google Sheets CRM.
2. Examples of previous CRM/automation projects.
3. Experience working with existing Apps Script code.
4. Your usual response time for technical issues.

leads.title: Wildlife Trophy Tracker.
leads.description:
Backend Developer Needed for 4-App Outdoor Geospatial Suite (Lovable Frontend Complete)
Ghostbull LLC has engineered the conceptual blueprints, database workflows, and a high-fidelity frontend UI prototype (fully built and locked in on Lovable) for a unified, four-app outdoor geospatial ecosystem.
The suite shares a uniform backend data pipeline to keep cloud and server costs drastically low.
The 4-App Suite Includes:
1. Flagship Wildlife Interface: A regulatory-compliant hunting/angling field tracker built with a secure, privacy-first spatial data layout to build deep user trust.
2. Coastal Bounty: Localized Pacific Northwest foraging tracking (razor clams, mushroom zones, tide triggers) with offline safety functionality.
3. Bird Tracker: An authentic citizen-science migration tracker using camera checks to filter out AI gallery images.
4. Viral Growth Tool: A high-visibility regional cryptid/lore map tracker designed to drive massive organic consumer traffic to the broader suite.
WHAT WE NEED:
We need an independent backend developer or studio to take our working Lovable frontend code repositories and build out the secure backend database infrastructure, server connections, and live data feeds.
THE TRANSACTION:
We are offering a non-dilutable revenue-sharing split, sweat equity, or a full intellectual property asset assignment/buyout structured upon launch or acquisition

leads.title: Magento Digital Affiliate Integration
leads.description:
I run a Magento-based store that sells purely digital products, and I’m ready to launch an affiliate programme to extend our reach. What I need is a clean, fully tested integration that gives my team three core capabilities:

• Affiliate tracking that records clicks, leads and sales in real time  
• Commission management with flexible rules, tiered payouts and easy export for accounting  
• Branded referral links that affiliates can grab instantly from their dashboard  

You’re free to recommend or implement the extension or SaaS you feel fits Magento best—as long as it won’t slow the site and can handle future scale. I’ll supply server access, staging environment and current theme details. 

Acceptance is simple: once your work is live on staging, I’ll test each feature above, run a sample payout report and verify that data matches our Stripe receipts. When everything checks out, we move it to production.

leads.title: Cross-Platform Messaging App Development
leads.description:
I'm looking for an experienced app developer to create a messaging application for both iOS and Android platforms. The core functionality will be text messaging and sharing pictures.

Key requirements:
- Development for both iOS and Android
- Core features: Text messaging and picture sharing
- User-friendly interface
- Secure and reliable performance

Ideal skills and experience:
- Proficiency in mobile app development for iOS and Android
- Strong background in building messaging applications
- Expertise in UI/UX design
- Knowledge in implementing secure data transmission and storage

Please provide examples of similar work done. Looking forward to your bids!

leads.title: Realistic Mud Simulation for Custom Map
leads.description:
I'm looking for an experienced developer to enhance my PC map with a highly realistic mud simulation. 

Requirements:
- Create realistic mud textures and effects.
- Implement dynamic interaction, allowing vehicles to leave ruts and tracks.
- Ensure optimization for smooth performance on PC.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in custom map development.
- Strong background in environmental simulation.
- Experience with physics-based interactions in game environments.
- Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.

Please share relevant portfolio work with your bids.

leads.title: Dynamic Portfolio Site Rebuild
leads.description:
I’m ready to give my personal portfolio a full refresh and need a developer-designer who can turn the content I’ll supply into a fluid, graphics-driven experience that feels modern and creative rather than static.  

The site has to serve three goals at once: show off my work, impress potential employers, and host an ongoing blog. Smooth transitions, responsive layouts, and eye-catching visuals are key; think subtle animations or micro-interactions that make browsing feel effortless on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

I’ll hand over all copy, images, and project case studies. Your role is to rebuild the site architecture, implement the design, and make sure the blog section is easy for me to update later. Currently the site is present in Wordpress & with Hostinger Domain.

Please include in your bid:
• A concise proposal explaining how you would tackle the redesign, frameworks or libraries you’d use, and any performance or SEO considerations.  
• Links to past projects that prove you can blend strong visuals with clean, maintainable code.

Deliverables I expect:
1. Fully responsive, modern portfolio site deployed to my hosting.  
2. Integrated blog ready for new posts.  
3. Clear documentation or hand-off guide so I can update content without touching code.  

If your previous work shows a flair for interactive design and you’re comfortable steering both development and visual polish, I’d love to see your plan.

leads.title: Build Educational Courses Site
leads.description:
I need a developer who can turn my concept for an online educational courses platform into a fully-functioning, polished website. The site will host multiple courses under one roof, handle user registrations, allow secure payments, and make it easy for me to add or update lessons without touching code.

Here’s what I have in mind: a clean, mobile-friendly interface where visitors can browse a catalog, preview syllabi, then enroll and track their progress through video lessons, readings, and quizzes. An intuitive admin dashboard should let me upload new course content, bundle modules, set prices or offer free material, and view basic analytics on sign-ups and completion rates. I’d also like integrated discussion areas so learners can interact, plus automated email notifications to keep them engaged.

I’m flexible about the tech stack—WordPress with LearnDash, Moodle, Laravel + Vue, or another modern framework—so long as it delivers speed, security, and room to scale as the catalog grows. If you’ve already built similar e-learning or LMS solutions, please share links; seeing real examples will help me choose the best fit.

Deliverables:
• Responsive website with front-end course catalog, secure checkout, and user dashboard  
• Admin panel for course, user, and payment management  
• Basic progress tracking, quizzes, and completion certificates  
• Email setup for enrollment confirmations and reminders  
• Deployment to my hosting, with a short hand-off guide or recorded walkthr

leads.title: Ecommerce Marketing Expert Required
leads.description:
Ecommerce Marketing Specialist – Full-Time Hours

We are a growing Australian ecommerce business looking for an experienced Ecommerce Marketing Specialist to work with us on an ongoing basis, with full-time hours available for the right person.

The role will involve:

* Creating and managing email newsletters and marketing campaigns
* Planning and implementing promotions, specials and sales campaigns
* Optimising our Shopify websites to improve conversions and sales
* Setting up and improving email automations and customer retention campaigns
* Improving product pages, collections and website content
* Finding opportunities to increase average order value and repeat purchases
* Reviewing marketing performance and identifying areas for improvement
* Assisting with marketing across our different ecommerce brands and sales channels

We are looking for someone who is proactive and commercially focused — someone who can identify opportunities, suggest ideas and implement them rather than simply waiting for instructions.

Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo/email marketing and ecommerce marketing is highly preferred.

This will initially be a freelance/contractor position, however full-time hours and long-term ongoing work are available for the right person.

leads.title: Amazon-Shopify Setup & Optimization
leads.description:
I run an Australian Shopify-based store and it’s time to launch on Amazon the right way from day one. An Expert-level grasp of Amazon Seller Central is essential because the work starts with opening and configuring the seller account, enrolling our brands through Amazon Brand Registry, and making sure every compliance box is ticked before we list a single SKU.

Once the account foundation is solid, the Amazon sales channel must be linked to Shopify so inventory, price and order data flow automatically. I already use Shopify’s native Amazon integration, but I want a specialist who can fine-tune the connection, trace any sync errors, and prevent duplicate listings or stock mismatches.

With the technical plumbing in place, the next priority is high-conversion product pages. I’ll provide raw product data and creative assets; you polish the copy, refine keywords, structure parent/child variations and upload fully optimised listings that comply with Amazon style guides.

Key deliverables
• Fully configured Amazon Seller Central account, Australia and U.S. marketplaces activated  
• Successful Brand Registry approval for two existing trademarks  
• Shopify-Amazon channel connected and tested (inventory, pricing, order routing)  
• Five flagship products published with optimised titles, bullets, search terms, images and A+ eligibility confirmed  
• Issue log documenting any integration or listing errors and the fix applied  

Acceptance criteria
1. Inventory updates reflected in bot

leads.title: Development of a Premium, Automated Practice Management System (Notion Template & Google Sheets Ecosystem) for Independent Clinicians
leads.description:
Project Overview:
We are seeking an expert Notion Creator and Google Sheets Developer to build a comprehensive, high-value Practice Management System designed for independent therapists and private practitioners. The goal is to create a seamless, professional digital ecosystem that replaces expensive monthly SaaS subscriptions. This product will be delivered as a premium digital download bundle ready for commercial resale.
Scope of Work & Technical Specifications:
Module 1: Premium Notion Practice System
• Client Database: Robust tracking with linked relational records for sessions, notes, and invoicing.
• Session Notes & Attendance: Integrated tracking matrix with reusable client page templates for smooth note-taking.
• Goals & Progress Tracker: Relational database mapping client milestones, progress reviews, and clinical outcomes.

• Financial & Invoice Tra

leads.title: Creative Developer for Innovative FitTech Platform
leads.description:
We are building FITBUG, a new fitness technology platform, and are looking for an experienced creative frontend developer / web designer to help us design and build our public-facing website.

We already have an early website foundation built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP and Lenis. We are looking for someone who can take it from a technical foundation to a polished, distinctive website.

Design direction

We want the site to feel:

Minimal. Premium. Energetic. Modern. Interactive.

We do not want a typical SaaS website filled with feature cards, dashboards, stock imagery, excessive gradients or generic templates.

The site should use strong typography, excellent spacing, subtle depth and high-quality motion/interaction to create its character.

Think more along the lines of a creative/Awwwards-quality technology website, while remaining clean, fast and usable.

Website structure

This will initially be a focused one-page website, roughly consisting of:

1. Navigation
2. Hero
3. The problem / why FITBUG exists
4. The FITBUG connected ecosystem
5. Who FITBUG is for
6. Founder / story
7. Early access / contact
8. Minimal footer

We intentionally want to keep the amount of content limited. The quality of the experience is more important than adding many sections.

Hero direction

The hero is particularly important.

Our current concept is to visually communicate a connected fitness ecosystem.

Different fitness-related signals/icons can exist throughout an

leads.title: Ongoing Beauty Instagram Graphics
leads.description:
I am preparing to launch a modern hair brand and need a designer I can rely on for continuous Instagram visuals. The priority is social media graphics—specifically feed posts, stories, and Reels covers—that feel fresh, polished, and on brand.

Brand aesthetic  
Modern and minimal, clean typography with use of brand tones. I will supply brand inspirations, product photos, and copy; your role is to transform them into scroll-stopping content while keeping the grid cohesive.

Deliverables  
• Instagram feed posts (static and carousel)  
• Instagram story frames and highlight icons  
• Reels cover images sized for 1080 × 1920  

All files should be delivered in web-ready PNGs, named clearly and following Instagram’s sizing guidelines. I plan to release 3–6 graphics per week; the first batch will support the launch campaign, and successful collaboration will turn into ongoing work.

Acceptance criteria  
Consistent use of brand colours and fonts, easy readability on mobile, and a 5 day turn around.

If you have a track record of creating standout visuals for beauty or hair brands, I would love to see examples of your previous work.

leads.title: Performance Marketer for Indian Spice Brand
leads.description:
Job Title:
Meta Ads Expert + Social Media Page Creator for Premium D2C Indian Spice Brand (Gulf Market)
Project Description:
Hello, we are launching a premium D2C brand specializing in Authentic Pounded Spices (
and Original Turmeric. Our Shopify store is already under development by another developer, who is configuring Shopify Markets for 4 high-value Gulf countries (Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Jordan).
We now need an experienced Performance Marketer / Social Media Expert to handle our branding, pages, and ad campaigns from scratch.
Important Note: We are shipping directly from India via Air Freight, so we will strictly accept 100% PREPAID orders only. There will be NO Cash on Delivery (COD).
Key Responsibilities Required:
1. Social Media Creation: Create and fully optimize official Facebook and Instagram Business pages from scratch for our brand.
2. Technical Tracking Setup: Properly configure Meta Pixel and Conversions API on our Shopify store to ensure accurate data tracking and conversion analytics.
3. Sales Ad Campaigns: Set up and launch Sales/Purchase Conversion campaigns (not just traffic or basic leads) targeting Indian expats (using language filters like Marathi, Hindi, Malayalam) as well as premium health-conscious audiences in Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and Jordan.
4. Retargeting Strategy: Create Custom Audiences to set up a retargeting funnel for store visitors who don't complete the purchase.
Requirements:
• Proven experience in setting up Meta Pixel and Conversion

leads.title: Dog Breeding and Products Website Design
leads.description:
I'm looking for a skilled web developer to create a website dedicated to selling dogs and dog-related products, specifically dog food, treats, toys, and accessories. 

Key Requirements:
- User-friendly interface for showcasing and selling dog products.
- Possibly include e-commerce functionality, open to suggestions.

Ideal Skills:
- Experience in developing e-commerce websites.
- Knowledge of UI/UX design principles.
- Familiarity with pet industry trends is a plus. 

Please provide a portfolio with relevant work.

leads.title: Bachelorette Party Invite Design
leads.description:
I'm looking for a creative designer to craft a bachelorette party invitation. The theme is "One Last Trip to the Boy Aquarium," set in a hockey arena. 

Key Elements:
- Silhouetted hockey players
- Title on the jumbo tron
- Agenda at the bottom
- Subtle aquarium vibes in the background, like fish illustrations or something to nod to the joke. 

Ideal skills and experience:
- Graphic design proficiency
- Creativity in theme integration
- Experience with digital invitations

Need this done ASAP!

leads.title: Aplikasi Penjualan Android Dinamis
leads.description:
Saya membutuhkan sebuah aplikasi penjualan berbasis Android yang siap dipakai toko kecil sampai menengah. Fokus utamanya adalah pembayaran online terintegrasi sehingga pelanggan dapat menyelesaikan transaksi langsung di aplikasi tanpa berpindah ke kanal lain.  

Keunikan yang saya inginkan ada pada fleksibilitas tampilan: pengguna akhir harus bisa mengganti tema kustom sendiri (misalnya gaya font, ikon, set warna utama) tanpa perlu keahlian teknis. Saya ingin perubahan tema terjadi instan, cukup diatur dari menu pengaturan sederhana.

Ruang lingkup pekerjaan:
• Kembangkan aplikasi Android native atau Flutter/React Native—mana yang paling efisien—dengan modul pembayaran online (midtrans, xendit, atau gateway serupa).  
• Sediakan sistem manajemen tema kustom: file JSON atau dashboard internal yang memungkinkan impor/ekspor tema.  
• Sertakan dokumentasi cara menambah tema baru serta kode sumber terstruktur.  
• Testing fungsional: alur checkout, validasi pembayaran, dan penerapan tema harus berjalan mulus di Android 10–13.

Hasil akhir yang saya harapkan adalah APK siap rilis, source code ter‐versioning, dan panduan singkat deployment ke Google Play.

leads.title: Responsive Figma Mobile Screens
leads.description:
I have a straightforward job: design 5–6 clean, responsive screens in Figma that will look great on both mobile phones and tablets. Each screen is mostly text-based—think H1/H2 headings, short paragraphs, a form field or two, and clear call-to-action buttons. No complex dashboards or animations, just polished layout, good hierarchy, and consistent spacing.

Here’s what I need from you:  
• A single Figma file with all screens organised in frames for mobile and their tablet counterparts.  
• Styles and components set up so I can tweak colours or text later without breaking the layout.  
• Export instructions or assets only if any custom icons or illustrations are added. 


No agencies please. Budget is 1200 rupees.

leads.title: Grocery Store Bookkeeping Specialist
leads.description:
I'm seeking an experienced bookkeeper for my grocery store. 

Key tasks include:  
- Daily transactions recording  
- Monthly financial statements  

Requirements:  
- Proficiency in QuickBooks  
- Prior experience with retail bookkeeping  
- Strong attention to detail  
- Reliable and organized  

Communication will be primarily via email.

leads.title: Deploy Existing Laravel 9 + Vue App to Isolated Staging & Test Stripe/PayPal Sandbox Payments
leads.description:
I have an existing, fully developed web application built with Laravel 9, Vue 3, MySQL 8 and PHP 8.1. A substantial cumulative update package with code changes, database migrations and deployment notes will be supplied.

>>> This job is deployment, configuration and testing — NOT a rebuild, redesign or refactoring project.

You will:
1. Create an isolated staging installation with its own copy of the database. The existing website and all other projects must not be touched.
2. Deploy the supplied package according to its deployment instructions and configure the server, SSL, environment, permissions, queues and scheduler/cron as required.
3. Configure Stripe Test Mode and PayPal Sandbox. No real payments or live credentials will be used.
4. Thoroughly test the website in a real browser, including registrations, memberships, payments, upgrades, cancellations, webhooks, invoices, receipts, e-mails and the major user journeys.
5. Fix deployment/configuration problems. If you find an application-code problem, document it clearly rather than changing the application without my approval.

Deliverables: a fully working staging website plus a clear test report showing what was tested, what passed, what failed and supporting evidence.

The developer must self-test thoroughly. Payment will be released after I verify the staging website and completed work. 

Timeline: asap 
Budget: CAD$150-200

leads.title: Vibrant Cardboard Counter Display Design
leads.description:
I need a small, cardboard counter display unit created from scratch, complete with a full tech pack that a printer can take straight to production. The unit must be vibrant and colourful to grab attention at first glance, but it also has to solve three functional challenges:

• Product insert: the inner structure must hold each item perfectly upright, even on a busy till counter.  
• Eye-catching header: the top/back panel should act like a mini billboard, clearly explaining the product to first-time shoppers.  
• Tester holder: work in a dedicated spot for a tester with the printed prompt “Tester / Twist me open.”

Practicalities matter as much as looks. The design should flat-pack efficiently so retailers can ship or store it with individual units nested inside the outer carton. Please include dielines, material call-outs, print layers, assembly steps, and any suggested finishes or coatings that keep the colours punchy without compromising budget.

If you have experience engineering small POS displays from corrugated or solid board and can translate creative ideas into precise manufacturing files, I’d love to see how you’d tackle this.

leads.title: Full-Stack Developer for CRM SaaS Platform- REplit
leads.description:
We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to assist with the development, optimisation, and completion of a CRM SaaS platform currently being built on Replit.

The platform is a multi-tenant SaaS CRM designed to manage customers, bookings/jobs, users, workflows, reporting, integrations, and operational processes.

The existing application has already been substantially developed, so this is not a project starting from scratch. We need a developer who can review the current codebase, understand the existing architecture, improve performance, fix bugs, develop new features, and ensure the platform is scalable and secure.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Integration 
- Review and improve the existing Replit codebase
- Full-stack frontend and backend development
- Improve application speed, performance, and code quality
- Build and maintain multi-tenant SaaS architecture
- Ensure proper tenant data separation and security
- Develop Super Admin and tenant administration functionality
- Build new CRM modules and workflows
- Work with databases, APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations
- Implement user roles and permissions
- Troubleshoot bugs and improve system reliability
- Assist with deployment, testing, and future scaling

Experience with technologies commonly used in Replit projects such as JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL and modern API development would be highly regarded.

Experience building CRM, SaaS, ERP, booking, dispatch, inventor

leads.title: Autodesk Inventor ABS Plastic Case for Printed Circuit Board -- 2
leads.description:
I have designed in Inventor a plastic case for a circuit board. However, I need a professional designer who understands injection moulding draft angles and how to perfect the model so that it is ready for production.

All critical dimensions are already defined so you can work directly from my exact measurements and board outline. The finished housing must fully enclose the PCB while integrating the following functional details: ventilation slots around the component hot-spots, clean mounting holes that line up with my chassis and connector port entry points.

I can share my IPT file and photos of what I have made so far.

Deliverables I need back:
• Inventor part/assembly files (.ipt/.iam)
• Manufacturing-ready STL or STEP export 
• A 2D drawing showing overall size, critical hole locations, and slot geometry for the injection moulding engineers.

If you have experience designing plastic enclosures for electronics, this should be a very straightforward project. I am currently stuck on the clip design.

Let me know how quickly you can turn the first draft around and feel free to suggest any tweaks that could improve the design.

leads.title: Honeybee WordPress Site Development
leads.description:
I need a clean, fast WordPress website that puts my honeybee business front-and-center. The main goal is simple: showcase what we do, why we care about bees, and entice visitors to explore (and eventually buy) our range of honey and hive-related products.

Core pages and sections  
• Home page that instantly communicates our brand story with striking hero imagery of our apiaries  
• Product area where each jar, comb, or candle is presented with crisp photos and engaging descriptions  
• Beekeeping blog—an easy-to-update section where I can share tips, behind-the-scenes hive news, and seasonal updates  
• About/Contact page with an embedded form so customers can reach out for bulk orders or farm visits

What matters most  
– Built on standard WordPress so I can handle routine edits myself  
– Mobile-first layout, quick page loads, and solid on-page SEO foundations  
– Straightforward admin workflow for adding new products or blog posts without touching code

If you normally work with Elementor, Gutenberg blocks, or a similar visual builder, let me know—ease of use for future updates is a priority. I will supply brand colours, logo files, and initial photography as soon as the project kicks off.

Hand-over items  
1. Fully configured WordPress site on my chosen host  
2. All theme files, child theme (if used), and plugins documented  
3. Brief video or written guide showing how to add a new product and a new blog post

I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right developer. S

leads.title: WooCommerce Store with Payments
leads.description:
I need a clean, fully-functional WooCommerce site spun up quickly. The focus is straightforward: sell physical products that I already list on a handful of Etsy shops. Use any of the popular import plugins to pull titles, descriptions, photos, variants, stock levels and keep them in sync where possible, so manual upkeep is minimal.

Once the catalogue is in place, configure the checkout flow end-to-end. The source data will arrive in CSV or via API from our survey platform, so you’ll need to build (or hook into) an automated pipeline that fetches the latest file, stores it securely—MySQL, Postgres or a lightweight NoSQL solution is fine—and refreshes the view. Near-real-time isn’t critical, but a scheduled pull every few minutes would be perfect.  

Alongside the dashboard, I need a configurable redirect handler. After respondents complete a survey they should land on one of several URLs based on logic I supply (quota status, country, mobile vs desktop, and so on). A simple rules engine or endpoint that reads parameters and pushes them to the right destination will cover it.  

Tech stack is flexible: React, Vue, or plain JavaScript on the front end; Node.js, Python (FastAPI / Django), or PHP on the back end—use what you’re quickest with as long as it’s well-documented and container-friendly (Docker).  

Key deliverables

I’ll provide pin-outs, mechanical constraints and target board size at project start. If you follow IPC best practices, keep via counts reasonable and confirm net integrity with ERC/DRC before hand-off, we’ll be in great shape. Looking forward to seeing your approach.
